_readme: Every active source the daily run checks, besides the official Ubisoft channels in AUTOMATION.md section 2a. Built from the owner's 'Active Sources' spreadsheet (as of 2026-10-25). Trust levels are defined in AUTOMATION.md section 2c: only 'official' sources can carry a game fact on their own. The owner curates this list; the daily run records what it saw in automation/state.json (sources.<id>) and suggests additions or removals in its summary instead of editing this file.

data.name: Steam review summary
data.check: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749720/ (the review summary near the top: recent and all-time label, percentage and count). The appreviews JSON endpoint redirected to the store homepage on 2026-10-25, so don't rely on it.
data.lookFor: Record the summary label and counts. A change of label (for example Mixed to Mostly Positive) is worth a line in a future roundup, not a post on its own.

data.name: APKMirror: Android builds
data.lookFor: A version newer than the one in state. A new client build is a lead that a patch shipped: look for notes on Steam, the Help Center and @TheDivMobile. Never post from a version number alone.

data.name: SteamDB: PC builds and store changes
data.lookFor: A new public build or depot update since the last run (a lead, same rule as APKMirror). SteamDB often refuses automated reads: if it does, mark it blocked and move on; never use mirrors or caches.

data.name: Raijin.gg: Steam player counts
data.lookFor: Record players in game, this month's average and peak. Numbers for a future monthly roundup; not post-worthy on their own.

data.name: Official Discord member counts
data.lookFor: Record the two counts. The channels themselves can't be read; Discord announcements also go out on X or Steam.

community.name: Steam Community discussions
community.lookFor: New threads since the last run. Highlight replies from Ubisoft or developer accounts, event announcements, and problems many players report (leads to check against the bug reporter and patch notes). Player posts are never facts; don't quote insults.

community.name: r/thedivisionresurgence
community.check: Do not open Reddit (blocked for our tools; never use mirrors, archives or proxies). Use WebSearch only to spot a new official post, e.g. "thedivisionresurgence reddit patch notes" or "TDResurgence reddit".
community.lookFor: A new post by an official account (u/TDResurgence, u/Ticksyy, u/JokerUnique). If you see one, list its title and date in the summary and ask the owner for a Reddit export. Never publish from a search snippet. Content comes only from owner exports in game_knowledge/reddit/.

streaming.note: Streams are context, never a source of game facts. Check the aggregate pages first; they cover every streamer below. Open an individual channel only when an aggregate page can't be read or shows something unusual (a developer stream, a Drops campaign, an event).

aggregates.name: Twitch: game category
aggregates.lookFor: Drops campaigns (Drops Enabled tags) and official Ubisoft channel streams. Twitch pages often don't render for automated reads; fall back to WebSearch "Division Resurgence Twitch Drops". Drops are post-worthy only when an official source confirms them.

aggregates.name: Streams Charts: who streamed it (30 days)
aggregates.lookFor: Which listed streamers streamed since the last run, and any new channel with a real audience.

aggregates.name: SullyGnome: game stats
aggregates.lookFor: Record 30-day hours watched, streamers and peak viewers (for a future monthly roundup).

aggregates.name: Kick: game category
aggregates.lookFor: Anyone live or notable; Kick often blocks automated reads, so mark it and move on.

searches.note: Catch-all WebSearch queries for news from outlets that aren't listed or that block automated reads. Search only; never fetch a site that refuses automated reads, and never use mirrors or caches. Everything found this way is 'unverified' until an official source confirms it.
daily: "Division Resurgence" update OR patch OR season
searches.outletsHowTo: Daily, run one or two combined searches such as "Division Resurgence" site:gamerant.com OR site:thegamer.com OR site:ign.com (split the list across a few queries). List new headlines in the summary; treat them as leads.

youtube.note: The owner pulls transcripts; never try to fetch transcripts or scrape YouTube pages. On 2026-10-25 our fetch tool refused every RSS feed here (YouTube's robots rules), so each run tries one watch-list feed and skips the rest if it's still refused (AUTOMATION.md 2d). If the feeds load, list new videos whose titles suggest a build, test, guide, tips or update news (skip livestreams, walkthrough parts and Shorts) under 'Transcripts worth pulling'. The other channels are listed for reference.
